annotation.title_clean: 工业和信息化部关于印发《人形机器人创新发展指导意见》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on the Innovative Development of Humanoid Robots
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 工业和信息化部 (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, China); reposted on Beijing International Science and Technology Innovation Center platform
annotation.venue: 北京国际科技创新中心网络服务平台
annotation.summary_en: Beijing innovation-center portal page reposting the MIIT transmittal notice (工信部科〔2023〕193号, 20 Oct 2023) issuing the Guiding Opinions on Innovative Development of Humanoid Robots. Only the cover notice appears; the guidance text itself is not reproduced, so substantive provisions are not visible.
key_provisions_or_claims: MIIT issued the Humanoid Robot Innovation Development Guiding Opinions on 20 Oct 2023 (No. 193).
Notice directs provincial industry and IT authorities, associations and enterprises to implement it.
Page contains only the transmittal notice, not the guidance content.
